option_relations.rationale: Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) of the inferior wall is a subtype of myocardial infarction
Acute inferior ST-elevation myocardial infarction (secondary to saphenous vein graft occlusion) is a subtype of myocardial infarction
Acute posterior and inferior myocardial infarction (STEMI equivalent) due to saphenous vein graft occlusion is a subtype of myocardial infarction
Coronary artery disease progression with graft failure is not directly related to myocardial infarction

decisions.rationale: Graft failure can lead to myocardial infarction as a complication
